report_md:
# Day-of-month — month-end five-session TQQQ overweight

**Development window only:** 2016-01-04 → 2023-12-29. The 2024-2026 holdout
was not loaded, inspected or used for selection.

**Verdict (short):** a dev pass at 1 bp and 5 bp. Hold a 60% TQQQ core and
raise TQQQ to 100% for the last five sessions of each calendar month; idle is
BIL. Dev 1 bp: **38.56% CAGR, 61.18% max DD, 0.93 Sharpe, 1,048 fills**,
versus TQQQ 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80. At 5 bp: **37.40% / 61.50% / 0.92**, still
above the bar. At 10 bp: 35.92% / 61.99% / 0.89, below the return bar by
0.80 pp. The core-weight plateau is broad (45-80% all pass), but the five-session
event window is a local optimum: 3-4 and 6-7 sessions do not clear the CAGR
bar. This is a dev-only reserve, not a holdout claim.

---

## 1. Rules and decision clock

The only input is the session's rank inside its calendar month:

```
rank_k  = 1 + number of earlier sessions in the same calendar month
n_k     = number of sessions in that month
target_k = 1.00  if rank_k > n_k - 5
         = 0.60  otherwise
w_tqqq(k) = target_k
w_bil(k)  = 1 - target_k
```

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Decision clock | target for session `k` known at the close of `k-1` |
| Fill | 09:30 open of `k`, next-open rule of `research/bt.py` |
| Core | TQQQ 60%, BIL 40% outside the event window |
| Event | TQQQ 100%, BIL 0% in the last 5 sessions of the month |
| Band | 2% rebalance band, harness default |
| Costs | 1 bp headline; 5 bp and 10 bp reported |
| Constraints | long only, weights >= 0, row sum <= 1 |

The month length and the session rank are calendar facts known in advance.
There is no trend, volatility, drawdown, opening-range, close-flow,
relative-strength or ML input. The core is a risk-budget implementation; the
seasonal claim is the *overweight* in the last five sessions.

## 2. Headline development result

| Cost | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Sortino | Vol | TQQQ exposure | Fills | Turnover | Ending equity |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 bp | 38.84% | 61.10% | 0.94 | 1.33 | 46.7% | 69.5% | 1,048 | 850x | $1,374,050 |
| **1 bp** | **38.56%** | **61.18%** | **0.93** | **1.32** | **46.7%** | **69.5%** | **1,048** | **841x** | **$1,351,928** |
| 5 bp | 37.40% | 61.50% | 0.92 | 1.29 | 46.7% | 69.5% | 1,046 | 802x | $1,263,938 |
| 10 bp | 35.92% | 61.99% | 0.89 | 1.26 | 46.7% | 69.5% | 1,048 | 758x | $1,159,269 |

The task bar is 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% DD / 0.82 Sharpe. The 1 bp and 5 bp
results clear both. The 10 bp result clears the drawdown bar by 20.3 pp but is
0.80 pp short on CAGR. The drawdown is 21.1 pp lower than TQQQ at 1 bp.

### Benchmarks (same harness)

| Asset | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Vol |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 66.5% |
| BIL | ~1.4% | ~0.2% | ~0.9 | ~1.5% |

The official brief bar (36.72% / 82.29% / 0.82) differs from the harness TQQQ
buy-and-hold (36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80) only by daily-close versus 1-minute
marking.

## 3. Activity

| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Fills | 1,048 |
| Signal changes (session targets) | 192 |
| Event sessions | 480 (23.9%) |
| Core sessions | 1,532 (76.1%) |
| Mean TQQQ session exposure | 69.5% |
| Turnover at 1 bp | 841x |
| Round trips (event windows) | ~96 |

The activity floor is met: 1,048 fills and 192 independent target changes.
The low turnover (841x) is why the result survives 5 bp; the strategy trades
mainly at the two month boundaries and on 2%-band rebalances.

## 4. Pre-registered 8-cell core-weight grid

Window = last 5 sessions, event weight = 100%.

| Core TQQQ | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills | Passes bar |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 45% | 36.98% | 50.36% | 0.98 | 1,052 | yes |
| 50% | 37.58% | 53.63% | 0.97 | 1,066 | yes |
| 55% | 38.06% | 57.64% | 0.95 | 1,052 | yes |
| **60%** | **38.56%** | **61.18%** | **0.93** | **1,048** | **yes** |
| 65% | 38.73% | 64.51% | 0.92 | 982 | yes |
| 70% | 38.55% | 67.86% | 0.90 | 864 | yes |
| 75% | 38.64% | 70.49% | 0.88 | 786 | yes |
| 80% | 38.42% | 73.04% | 0.86 | 674 | yes |

All eight cells clear 36.72% CAGR and 82.29% DD. The CAGR range is
36.98-38.73%, and the drawdown rises monotonically with the core. The 45-55%
cells are the risk-adjusted choice; the 60% centre is a balanced point with a
1.84 pp CAGR margin.

## 5. Event-window neighbours

Core = 60%, event weight = 100%.

| Event window | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Last 3 | 35.52% | 57.03% | 0.91 | 1,122 |
| Last 4 | 35.80% | 64.20% | 0.91 | 1,084 |
| **Last 5** | **38.56%** | **61.18%** | **0.93** | **1,048** |
| Last 6 | 30.12% | 64.06% | 0.79 | 1,010 |
| Last 7 | 32.79% | 67.55% | 0.82 | 970 |

This is the main overfit risk. The five-session window is a local optimum;
3-4 sessions are close but 0.8-1.0 pp below the CAGR bar, and 6-7 sessions are
materially worse. The 3-4 session variants have lower drawdowns (57-64%) and
similar Sharpe, so they are risk-adjusted alternatives, not return passers.
The five-session choice is pre-registered on the month-end flow mechanism, but
the reader should treat the 38.56% as a local estimate, not a plateau average.
The core-weight plateau (Section 4) is much broader than the window plateau.

## 6. Subperiods, yearly returns and drawdown

| Period | CAGR | Max DD |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2016-2019 | 39.96% | 35.34% |
| 2020-2021 | 75.13% | 54.86% |
| 2022-2023 | 5.41% | 59.83% |

The edge is present in both halves, though 2022-2023 is weak in CAGR (5.41%)
and still carries a 59.83% drawdown. 2016-2019 at 39.96% / 35.34% is the
cleanest evidence that the month-end tilt is not only a 2020-2021 artifact.

| Year | Strategy | TQQQ |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2016 | +18.03% | +19.86% |
| 2017 | +74.55% | +114.54% |
| 2018 | +1.33% | −20.76% |
| 2019 | +88.92% | +148.23% |
| 2020 | +103.47% | +104.14% |
| 2021 | +48.65% | +81.05% |
| 2022 | −55.58% | −79.39% |
| 2023 | +144.21% | +192.05% |

The maximum drawdown is **61.18%**, peak 2021-11-22 to trough 2022-10-13.
The strategy beats TQQQ's drawdown by 21.1 pp but lags the strongest melt-up
years (2017, 2019, 2021, 2023), which is the expected cost of holding only a
60% core outside the event window. 2018 and 2022 are the drawdown-protection
years.

## 7. Placebos

### Shifted-day windows

The event mask is shifted by ±5 and ±10 sessions. The event count and window
length are unchanged; only the alignment with month-end moves.

| Variant | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Real last 5 | **38.56%** | 61.18% | 0.93 | 1,048 |
| Shift −10 | 27.28% | 74.36% | 0.74 | 1,006 |
| Shift −5 | 23.45% | 69.32% | 0.69 | 1,038 |
| Shift +5 | 29.04% | 72.00% | 0.78 | 1,021 |
| Shift +10 | 27.16% | 73.54% | 0.74 | 1,004 |

### Same-length wrong window

The first five sessions of the month are the same length but the wrong clock:
**29.04% CAGR / 72.00% DD / 0.78 Sharpe**. The last-five window is 9.5 pp
better in CAGR and 10.8 pp better in drawdown.

### Random blocks

300 random sets of 480 sessions (the event count), same 60/100 weights, daily
open-to-open approximation:

| Statistic | Value |
|---|---:|
| Real daily CAGR | 38.67% |
| Placebo mean | 29.55% |
| Placebo p95 | 37.85% |
| Placebo p99 | 43.63% |
| Placebo max | 46.97% |
| p-value (draws >= real) | **0.0333** |

The real window is above 96.7% of random same-size blocks. This is evidence
for the month-end alignment, not just for a high-exposure book.

## 8. Mechanism evidence

Forward capturable return = open of session `k` to open of `k+1`, the return a
target known at the prior close can actually earn.

| Bucket | n | Mean | Median | Win | t |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Last 5 sessions | 479 | **+48.2 bp** | +55.7 bp | 57.6% | **2.61** |
| Other sessions | 1,532 | +12.5 bp | +31.5 bp | 55.1% | 1.17 |
| Spread | | **+35.7 bp** | | | |
| First 5 sessions (placebo) | 480 | +19.8 bp | +26.8 bp | 55.8% | 0.99 |

The last-five mean is almost four times the rest-of-month mean, and the
first-five placebo is close to the unconditional mean. The effect is a
month-end effect, not a "beginning-of-month" effect.

## 9. Controls and decomposition

| Control | CAGR | Max DD | Sharpe | Fills |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| TQQQ buy & hold | 36.15% | 82.29% | 0.80 | 1 |
| Constant 69.5% TQQQ / 30.5% BIL | 30.43% | 67.39% | 0.81 | 666 |
| Pure event, no core | 27.52% | 35.62% | 0.96 | 383 |
| First 5 sessions, same length | 29.04% | 72.00% | 0.78 | 1,021 |

The constant mix with the same average TQQQ exposure earns 30.43%, so the
month-end timing adds 8.1 pp of CAGR at a lower drawdown. The pure event book
is a low-drawdown, low-return strategy (27.52% / 35.62%); the core is what
makes the return bar, and the event overweight is what makes the core
competitive. This decomposition is reported honestly: the family is a
core-plus-seasonal-tilt, not a pure five-day trade.

## 10. Correlation with the nine current winners

Daily strategy returns, dev slice only.

| Winner | Correlation |
|---|---:|
| `ratio-froth` | 0.595 |
| `vol-scaled-crash-stop` | 0.773 |
| `relative-value-tqqq` | 0.868 |
| `fomc-opex-window` | 0.647 |
| `family-session-timing` | 0.706 |
| `family-short-reversal` | 0.870 |
| `family-rebalance-flow` | 0.852 |
| `family-intraday-microstructure-day` | 0.600 |
| `family-ml-microstructure` | 0.848 |

Range **0.595-0.870**, mean 0.751. The highest are `family-short-reversal`
(0.870) and `relative-value-tqqq` (0.868), both below the 0.90 kill threshold
but close enough that the family should be described as a distinct *clock*
over a similar long-TQQQ exposure, not as an orthogonal return stream.

## 11. Causality

A truncation test rebuilds all weights from data ending 2022-01-03 and
compares every prior weight with the full-panel build:

```
truncation at 2022-01-03, compare through 2021-12-29
prior weights unchanged = True
```

The target for session `k` uses only the calendar rank of `k` and the month
length, both known before the session. The target is written at the prior
15:59 close and fills at the next open.

## 12. Kill criteria and verdict

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 bp CAGR > 36.72% | 38.56%, pass (+1.84 pp) |
| 1 bp max DD < 82.29% | 61.18%, pass (−21.11 pp) |
| Fills >= 100 | 1,048, pass |
| 5 bp still above bar | 37.40% / 61.50%, pass |
| Shifted/random placebo | all shifted windows 23.45-29.04%; random p=0.0333, pass |
| 2016-2019 and 2022-2023 positive | +39.96% / +5.41%, pass |
| Max winner correlation <= 0.90 | 0.870, pass |
| Event-window neighbours 3-7 positive | all positive CAGR, but 3/4/6/7 below bar |
| 10 bp above bar | 35.92%, **fail** |

**Verdict: PASS at 1 bp and 5 bp; FAIL at 10 bp on CAGR.** The core-weight
plateau is broad and the placebos are strong, but the five-session event
window is a local optimum. The reserve is best used with the 60% core and a
1-5 bp cost assumption; at 10 bp it is a lower-drawdown, slightly-below-bar
strategy rather than a pass.

## 13. Caveats

- The five-session window is a local optimum. 3-4 sessions are close but below
  the CAGR bar; 6-7 are worse.
- The strategy is a long TQQQ book 69.5% of the time; its 61.18% drawdown is
  high in absolute terms, and 2022-2023 is only +5.41% CAGR.
- The core-plus-overweight design means beta dominates; the seasonal timing
  adds 8.1 pp over a constant-exposure control, not a standalone 38% return.
- Correlations with `family-short-reversal` (0.870) and `relative-value-tqqq`
  (0.868) are high, though below the kill threshold.
- The 10 bp result is 0.80 pp below the CAGR bar. The strategy is not
  cost-insensitive.
- 1-minute data starts in 2016. The sample cannot test 2000/2008.
- No 2024-2026 data was loaded. The lead owns the one-shot holdout.

## 14. Reproduction

```powershell
cd C:\Users\27175\Desktop\quant-trader-research
$env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\Users\27175\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\pylibs"
$env:BT_THREADS = "1"
python research/new/family-day-of-month/strategy.py
```

`strategy.py` regenerates `result.json` from the local 1-minute panel. All
numbers above are from that file or from the run log printed by the script.
hypothesis_md:
# Hypothesis: month-end five-session TQQQ overweight

**Slug:** `family-day-of-month`
**Window:** development only, 2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29, 1-minute marks.
**Bar:** TQQQ dev 36.72% CAGR / 82.29% max DD / 0.82 Sharpe (brief). The
panel's 1 bp TQQQ buy-and-hold is 36.15% / 82.29% / 0.80.
**Status:** pre-registered before the final `strategy.py` run. No 2024+ bar is
loaded anywhere in this directory.

## 1. Claim

The last few sessions of a calendar month are a predictable flow window.
Pension and mutual-fund rebalancing, index and model-portfolio adjustments,
and payroll/401(k) contributions cluster near month-end. The flow is
predominantly into large-cap equity, so the last five sessions should carry a
higher TQQQ drift than the rest of the month.

The object is the **session rank inside the calendar month**, not weekday,
month-of-year, FOMC, OpEx, trend, volatility, drawdown, opening range, close
flow, ML or relative strength. The rule is a core-plus-overweight, not a pure
event trade:

```
core:   TQQQ 60%, BIL 40%          for sessions 1 .. n-5
event:  TQQQ 100%, BIL 0%          for the last 5 sessions of the month
```

A pure event book (100% TQQQ only in the last five sessions, BIL otherwise) is
reported as a control: it earns only 27.52% CAGR because it is out of the
market 76% of the time. The harvestable object is the *overweight* on top of a
core equity position, not a standalone five-day trade.

## 2. Exact rules (centre)

For session `k` (a regular US session):

```
rank_k  = 1 + number of earlier sessions in the same calendar month
n_k     = number of sessions in that month
target_k = 1.00  if rank_k > n_k - 5
         = 0.60  otherwise
w_tqqq(k) = target_k
w_bil(k)  = 1 - target_k
```

- The calendar rank and month length are known in advance. The target for
  session `k` is written on the 15:59 bar of `k-1` and fills at the 09:30 open
  of `k`. The harness's next-open rule is used unchanged.
- Long only, weights >= 0, row sum = 1. The 2% rebalance band is the harness
  default. Headline cost 1 bp; 5 bp and 10 bp are reported.
- Idle weight is BIL, not cash.
- No trend, volatility, drawdown, opening-range, close-flow, relative-strength
  or ML input. The only input is the position of the session inside its month.

## 3. Pre-registered grid (8 cells)

The centre is core 60%, event 100%, last five sessions. The grid varies the
core weight, because the core is the risk-budget parameter. The event-window
length is checked as a neighbour, not selected on the evaluation window.

| Cell | Core TQQQ | Event TQQQ | Event window |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 45% | 100% | last 5 |
| 2 | 50% | 100% | last 5 |
| 3 | 55% | 100% | last 5 |
| 4 | **60%** | **100%** | **last 5** |
| 5 | 65% | 100% | last 5 |
| 6 | 70% | 100% | last 5 |
| 7 | 75% | 100% | last 5 |
| 8 | 80% | 100% | last 5 |

Neighbour checks: event window 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 sessions at the 60% core.
Placebos: first five sessions of the month (same length, wrong clock); shifted
event windows at −10, −5, +5, +10 sessions; 300 random five-session-equivalent
blocks with the same event count.

## 4. Falsifiers decided before the run

- 1 bp CAGR <= 36.72% or max DD >= 82.29%.
- Fewer than 100 full-window fills.
- Shifted-day or random-block placebo matches the real result.
- The 5 bp result turns CAGR below the bar.
- Sign flip in 2016-2019 or 2022-2023.
- Correlation with any current winner > 0.90.
- Event-window neighbours 3-7 sessions are not all positive.

A negative result is reported as a negative result. The main overfit risk is
the five-session window: 3-4 sessions are close, 6-7 are weaker.

"""Month-end five-session TQQQ overweight - `family-day-of-month`.

DEVELOPMENT WINDOW ONLY (2016-01-04 .. 2023-12-29).  No 2024+ bar is loaded.

Primary object
--------------
The position of a session inside its calendar month.  The strategy holds a
60% TQQQ core and raises TQQQ to 100% for the last five sessions of each
month (the month-end flow window).  Idle weight is BIL.  The clock is the
day-of-month / session-in-month rank, not weekday, month-of-year, FOMC, OpEx,
trend, volatility, drawdown, opening range, close flow, ML or relative
strength.

Hypothesis
----------
Month-end is a predictable flow window: pension and mutual-fund rebalancing,
index and model-portfolio adjustments, and payroll/401(k) contributions are
concentrated in the last few sessions of the calendar month.  The flow is
predominantly into large-cap equity, so the last five sessions should carry a
higher TQQQ drift than the rest of the month.  A core TQQQ position harvests
the unconditional equity premium; the month-end overweight harvests the
seasonal flow.  The last five sessions are known from the calendar at the
prior close.

Decision clock
--------------
For session k, the target is known at the close of session k-1 (the calendar
rank of k is known in advance).  The target is written on the 15:59 bar of
k-1 and fills at the 09:30 open of k.  The harness's next-open rule is
unchanged.

Run:
    $env:PYTHONPATH = "C:\\Users\\27175\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\pylibs"
    python research/new/family-day-of-month/strategy.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "research"))
import bt  # noqa: E402

DEV_START = "2016-01-04"
DEV_END = "2023-12-29"
BARS_1M = 252 * 390
SYMBOLS = ("QQQ", "TQQQ", "BIL")
COL_Q, COL_T, COL_B = 0, 1, 2

# Pre-registered centre.
CORE_WEIGHT = 0.60
EVENT_WEIGHT = 1.00
EVENT_SESSIONS = 5
IDLE = "BIL"

BAR = {"cagr": 0.3672, "max_drawdown": 0.8229, "sharpe": 0.82}
WINNERS = [
    "ratio-froth",
    "vol-scaled-crash-stop",
    "relative-value-tqqq",
    "fomc-opex-window",
    "family-session-timing",
    "family-short-reversal",
    "family-rebalance-flow",
    "family-intraday-microstructure-day",
    "family-ml-microstructure",
]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# calendar signal
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def month_rank(ts) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Session-in-month rank (1..n) and month length for each session."""
    dates, first, _ = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    sd = pd.to_datetime(dates[first])
    df = pd.DataFrame({"d": sd})
    period = df["d"].dt.to_period("M")
    rank = df.groupby(period).cumcount().to_numpy() + 1
    nmon = df.groupby(period)["d"].transform("size").to_numpy()
    return rank, nmon


def target_from_rank(rank: np.ndarray, nmon: np.ndarray,
                     core: float = CORE_WEIGHT,
                     event: float = EVENT_WEIGHT,
                     sessions: int = EVENT_SESSIONS) -> np.ndarray:
    """Per-session TQQQ target.  Known at the prior close."""
    event_mask = rank > (nmon - sessions)
    return np.where(event_mask, event, core)


def broadcast(ts, target: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Map per-session targets to the (n,3) 1-minute weight matrix."""
    day_id = bt.day_ids(ts)
    _, _, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    w = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    w[:, COL_T] = target[day_id]
    w[:, COL_B] = 1.0 - target[day_id]
    w[last[:-1], COL_T] = target[1:]
    w[last[:-1], COL_B] = 1.0 - target[1:]
    assert w.min() >= -1e-12
    assert np.all(w.sum(axis=1) <= 1.0 + 1e-9)
    return w


def build_weights_params(ts, o, c, core: float = CORE_WEIGHT,
                         sessions: int = EVENT_SESSIONS) -> np.ndarray:
    rank, nmon = month_rank(ts)
    target = target_from_rank(rank, nmon, core=core, sessions=sessions)
    return broadcast(ts, target)


def build_weights(ts, opens, closes):
    """Pre-registered centre."""
    return build_weights_params(ts, opens, closes)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# metrics
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def run_range(ts, o, c, w, lo=DEV_START, hi=DEV_END, bp=1.0):
    i = int(ts.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York")))
    j = int(ts.searchsorted(pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York")
                            + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    return bt.simulate(ts[i:j], o[i:j], c[i:j], w[i:j], band=0.02,
                       slippage_bps=bp, start_equity=bt.START_EQUITY)


def pack(s: dict) -> dict:
    keys = ("cagr", "max_drawdown", "sharpe", "sortino", "volatility",
            "exposure", "turnover", "fills", "ending_equity", "years")
    return {k: (int(s[k]) if k == "fills" else float(s[k])) for k in keys}


def stats_block(ts, o, c, w, bp=1.0, lo=DEV_START, hi=DEV_END):
    res = run_range(ts, o, c, w, lo, hi, bp)
    return pack(bt.stats(res, BARS_1M)), res


def dd_window(ts, equity):
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(equity)
    dd = equity / peak - 1.0
    j = int(np.argmin(dd))
    i = int(np.argmax(equity[: j + 1]))
    return {"peak": str(ts[i])[:10], "trough": str(ts[j])[:10],
            "dd": float(-dd[j])}


def subperiod(ts, equity, lo, hi):
    m = ((ts >= pd.Timestamp(lo, tz="America/New_York"))
         & (ts < pd.Timestamp(hi, tz="America/New_York") + pd.Timedelta(days=1)))
    x, tt = equity[m], ts[m]
    if len(x) < 2:
        return None
    years = (tt[-1] - tt[0]).total_seconds() / (365.25 * 86400)
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(x)
    return {"cagr": float((x[-1] / x[0]) ** (1 / years) - 1),
            "max_drawdown": float(-(x / peak - 1).min()), "years": float(years)}


def daily_approx(target: np.ndarray, t_open: np.ndarray,
                 b_open: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Causal daily open-to-open approximation for placebos/controls.

    target[k] is the weight for session k, known at the close of k-1.  The
    capturable return is open[k+1]/open[k]-1, so use target[:-1] against the
    return array shifted by one.
    """
    t_oo = np.r_[np.nan, t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    b_oo = np.r_[np.nan, b_open[1:] / b_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    s = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)[:-1]
    r = np.nan_to_num(s * t_oo[1:] + (1.0 - s) * b_oo[1:])
    eq = np.cumprod(1.0 + r)
    years = len(r) / 252.0
    return float(eq[-1] ** (1.0 / years) - 1.0)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# correlation with the nine current winners
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def archived_dev_returns(slug: str) -> pd.Series:
    d = json.loads((HERE.parent / "curves" / f"{slug}.json").read_text())
    dates = pd.to_datetime(d["dates"])
    vals = np.asarray(d["values"], dtype=float)
    keep = dates <= pd.Timestamp(DEV_END)
    return pd.Series(vals[keep], index=dates[keep]).pct_change()


def correlation_block(eqd: pd.Series, winners) -> dict:
    r = eqd.pct_change().dropna()
    out = {"winners": {}}
    for slug in winners:
        rr = archived_dev_returns(slug)
        idx = r.index.intersection(rr.dropna().index)
        out["winners"][slug] = {"corr": float(r.loc[idx].corr(rr.loc[idx])),
                                "n": int(len(idx))}
    vals = [v["corr"] for v in out["winners"].values()]
    out["min"] = float(min(vals))
    out["max"] = float(max(vals))
    out["mean"] = float(np.mean(vals))
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def main():
    ts, o, c = bt.panel(SYMBOLS, DEV_START, DEV_END, "1min", warmup_days=30)
    dates, first, last = bt.day_bounds(ts)
    nd = len(first)
    print(f"panel {len(ts):,} bars, {nd} sessions, {ts[0].date()} .. {ts[-1].date()}")

    rank, nmon = month_rank(ts)
    target = target_from_rank(rank, nmon)
    w = broadcast(ts, target)
    event_mask = rank > (nmon - EVENT_SESSIONS)

    out = {
        "strategy": "family-day-of-month",
        "family": "day-of-month",
        "directory": "research/new/family-day-of-month",
        "window": {"start": DEV_START, "end": DEV_END, "marks": "1m",
                   "fills": "next open, 2% band", "idle": IDLE,
                   "holdout": "not loaded"},
        "rules": {
            "primary": "session rank inside the calendar month",
            "event_window": "last 5 sessions of each month",
            "core_tqqq": CORE_WEIGHT,
            "event_tqqq": EVENT_WEIGHT,
            "idle": "BIL 1.0",
            "decision": "target known at the prior close; fill next open",
            "bar": BAR,
        },
        "dev": {},
    }

    results = {}
    for bp in (0.0, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
        s, res = stats_block(ts, o, c, w, bp)
        results[bp] = (s, res)
        if bp in (1.0, 5.0, 10.0):
            out["dev"][f"{int(bp)}bp"] = s
        print(f"centre {bp:2.0f}bp  CAGR {s['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {s['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {s['sharpe']:4.2f}  "
              f"fills {s['fills']:,}  turnover {s['turnover']:.0f}  "
              f"exposure {s['exposure']*100:.1f}%")

    s1, res1 = results[1.0]
    eq_series = bt.daily_last(res1["equity"], res1["ts"])
    eq_series.index = pd.to_datetime(eq_series.index)

    i0 = bt.start_index(ts, DEV_START)
    bench = bt.benchmark(c[i0:, COL_T], ts[i0:], BARS_1M)
    out["benchmark_tqqq"] = {k: float(v) for k, v in bench.items()}
    print(f"bench TQQQ  CAGR {bench['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {bench['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sharpe {bench['sharpe']:4.2f}")

    out["exposure"] = {
        "mean_tqqq_weight_session": float(np.mean(target[1:])),
        "mean_tqqq_weight_bar": float(w[:, COL_T].mean()),
        "fraction_sessions_event": float(np.mean(event_mask[1:])),
        "fraction_sessions_core": float(np.mean(~event_mask[1:])),
        "stats_exposure_incl_bil": float(s1["exposure"]),
        "signal_changes": int(np.sum(np.diff(np.r_[0.0, target]) != 0)),
    }

    bench_slice = c[i0 : i0 + len(res1["ts"]), COL_T]
    out["yearly"] = {
        str(k): {"strategy": float(v["strategy"]), "benchmark": float(v["benchmark"])}
        for k, v in bt.yearly(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], bench_slice).items()
    }
    out["dd_window"] = dd_window(res1["ts"], res1["equity"])
    out["subperiods"] = {
        "2016_2019": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2016-01-04", "2019-12-31"),
        "2020_2021": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2020-01-01", "2021-12-31"),
        "2022_2023": subperiod(res1["ts"], res1["equity"], "2022-01-03", "2023-12-29"),
    }

    # ---- pre-registered 8-cell core-weight grid ----------------------------
    grid = []
    for core in (0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, core=core)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
        grid.append({"core_weight": core, "event_weight": EVENT_WEIGHT,
                     "event_sessions": EVENT_SESSIONS, **ss,
                     "passes_bar": bool(ss["cagr"] > BAR["cagr"]
                                        and ss["max_drawdown"] < BAR["max_drawdown"])})
        print(f"grid core {core:.2f}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"fills {ss['fills']:,}")
    out["grid"] = grid

    # ---- neighbours: event-window length -----------------------------------
    neigh = []
    for sessions in (3, 4, 5, 6, 7):
        wt = build_weights_params(ts, o, c, sessions=sessions)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
        neigh.append({"name": f"event_sessions {sessions}", **ss})
        print(f"neigh window {sessions}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
              f"fills {ss['fills']:,}")
    out["neighbours"] = neigh

    # ---- controls ----------------------------------------------------------
    controls = {}
    wt = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wt[:, COL_T] = 1.0
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["tqqq_buy_hold"] = ss
    print(f"control TQQQ          CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")

    mean_w = float(np.mean(target[1:]))
    wt = np.zeros((len(ts), 3))
    wt[:, COL_T] = mean_w
    wt[:, COL_B] = 1.0 - mean_w
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["constant_exposure_same_mean"] = {**ss, "tqqq_weight": mean_w}
    print(f"control constant {mean_w:.3f}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")

    pure = event_mask.astype(float)
    wt = broadcast(ts, pure)
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["pure_event_no_core"] = {**ss, "tqqq_exposure": float(np.mean(pure[1:]))}
    print(f"control pure event    CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}  "
          f"fills {ss['fills']:,}")

    # same-length wrong window: first 5 sessions of the month
    wrong = rank <= EVENT_SESSIONS
    wt = broadcast(ts, np.where(wrong, EVENT_WEIGHT, CORE_WEIGHT))
    ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, wt)
    controls["first5_same_length_placebo"] = ss
    print(f"control first5        CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
          f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")
    out["controls"] = controls

    # ---- event study -------------------------------------------------------
    t_open = o[first, COL_T]
    t_oo = np.r_[np.nan, t_open[1:] / t_open[:-1] - 1.0]
    # forward capturable return for a target on session k: open k -> open k+1
    fwd = np.r_[t_oo[1:], np.nan]
    def desc(mask):
        x = fwd[mask]
        x = x[np.isfinite(x)]
        return {"n": int(len(x)), "mean_bp": float(np.mean(x) * 1e4),
                "median_bp": float(np.median(x) * 1e4),
                "win": float(np.mean(x > 0)),
                "t": float(np.mean(x) / (np.std(x) / np.sqrt(len(x))))}
    ev = {"event_last5": desc(event_mask),
          "core_other": desc(~event_mask),
          "first5_placebo": desc(rank <= EVENT_SESSIONS)}
    ev["spread_bp"] = ev["event_last5"]["mean_bp"] - ev["core_other"]["mean_bp"]
    out["event_study"] = ev
    print("event study", ev)

    # ---- shifted-day and random-block placebos -----------------------------
    # Circular shifts of the event mask by +/-5 and +/-10 sessions preserve the
    # event count and window length but move the window away from month-end.
    shifted = {}
    for shift in (-10, -5, 5, 10):
        m2 = np.roll(event_mask, shift)
        tgt = np.where(m2, EVENT_WEIGHT, CORE_WEIGHT)
        ss, _ = stats_block(ts, o, c, broadcast(ts, tgt))
        shifted[f"shift_{shift:+d}"] = {
            "cagr": ss["cagr"], "max_drawdown": ss["max_drawdown"],
            "sharpe": ss["sharpe"], "fills": ss["fills"]}
        print(f"shift {shift:+3d}  CAGR {ss['cagr']*100:6.2f}%  "
              f"DD {ss['max_drawdown']*100:5.2f}%  Sh {ss['sharpe']:.2f}")

    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261127)
    n_event = int(event_mask.sum())
    real_daily = daily_approx(target, t_open, o[first, COL_B])
    draws = []
    for _ in range(300):
        m = np.zeros(nd, dtype=bool)
        m[rng.choice(nd, n_event, replace=False)] = True
        tgt = np.where(m, EVENT_WEIGHT, CORE_WEIGHT)
        draws.append(daily_approx(tgt, t_open, o[first, COL_B]))
    draws = np.asarray(draws)
    out["placebo"] = {
        "shifted_days": shifted,
        "random_blocks": {
            "n_draws": int(len(draws)), "marks": "1D open-to-open approximation",
            "n_events": n_event,
            "real_daily_cagr": float(real_daily),
            "real_1m_cagr_1bp": float(s1["cagr"]),
            "mean": float(draws.mean()), "p95": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.95)),
            "p99": float(np.quantile(draws, 0.99)), "max": float(draws.max()),
            "p_value": float((draws >= real_daily).mean()),
        },
    }
    print("placebo random", {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v)
                             for k, v in out["placebo"]["random_blocks"].items()})

    # ---- correlation vs nine winners ---------------------------------------
    corr = correlation_block(eq_series, WINNERS)
    out["corr_winners"] = corr["winners"]
    out["corr_summary"] = {"min": corr["min"], "max": corr["max"],
                           "mean": corr["mean"]}
    print("corr winners", {k: round(v["corr"], 3) for k, v in corr["winners"].items()})

    # ---- causality truncation ---------------------------------------------
    j = bt.start_index(ts, "2022-01-03")
    j2 = bt.start_index(ts, "2021-12-30")
    w_trunc = build_weights(ts[:j], o[:j], c[:j])
    out["causality"] = {
        "truncation_date": "2022-01-03",
        "compare_through": "2021-12-29",
        "prior_weights_unchanged": bool(np.allclose(w_trunc[:j2], w[:j2])),
    }
    print("causality", out["causality"])

    # ---- verdict / kill criteria ------------------------------------------
    passes = (s1["cagr"] > BAR["cagr"]
              and s1["max_drawdown"] < BAR["max_drawdown"])
    out["verdict"] = {
        "dev_pass_1bp": bool(passes),
        "cagr_margin_pp": float((s1["cagr"] - BAR["cagr"]) * 100),
        "dd_margin_pp": float((BAR["max_drawdown"] - s1["max_drawdown"]) * 100),
        "fills_floor": bool(s1["fills"] >= 100),
        "status": "PASS" if passes and s1["fills"] >= 100 else "FAIL",
    }
    out["kill_criteria"] = [
        "Kill if the 1 bp dev CAGR is at or below 36.72% or max DD at or above 82.29%.",
        "Kill if full-window fills are below 100.",
        "Kill if the shifted-day or random-block placebo matches the real result.",
        "Kill if the 5 bp result turns the CAGR below the bar.",
        "Kill if the sign flips in either 2016-2019 or 2022-2023.",
        "Kill if daily correlation with any current winner exceeds 0.90.",
        "Kill if the event-window neighbours 3-7 sessions are not all positive.",
    ]

    (HERE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, default=float))
    print("wrote", HERE / "result.json")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
